label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — the insecure randomness is used to generate a session ID/remember-me token (rememberMeKey) which is stored in a cookie and later retrieved from the session, making it a security-sensitive use of weak randomness. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — the user-provided value from the cookie (param) flows into the HTML response via the 'user' variable, which is directly printed in the response writer without proper encoding, creating a cross-site scripting vulnerability. Case TP: at least one alert is alert-TP.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness source (new java.util.Random().nextFloat()) used to generate rememberMeKey
User-provided value (param) flows into HTML response via 'user' variable
